description: Global Energy Statistics Yearbook Dataset is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Climate, Energy demand", published or maintained by Enerdata (Enerdata). Access 2023 world energy, climate data and key decarbonisation indices: On production, consumption and trade of oil, gas, coal, power and renewables; On CO2 emissions from fuel combustion; Covering 57 countries and regions throughout the world; Coverage from 1990 to 2022. Coverage: 7 countries in Sub-Saharan Africa, East Asia and the Pacific, Europe and Central Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, the Middle East and North Africa, South Asia. It has 1 file in XLS. The portal files it under Climate, Energy demand, Renewable energy. The portal gives 2023 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other non-commercial licence (terms as labelled in the catalogue, not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
